Hi Betsy,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Deadly Decaf while researching your work. I was particularly interested in a regular customer dropping dead mid-coffee.

Those details gave me an idea for how email marketing could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. The idea would be to add a newsletter so readers follow the Fort Wayne Murders series, staying close to how you already describe the books.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
